Stacy Driscoll took office on October, 14th 2025. The County Treasurers Office is responsible for collection of real estate, personal property and motor vehicle taxes, special assessments and other miscellaneous taxes for Leavenworth County. The Treasurer apportions and distributes such revenue to local taxing units. In addition, the Treasurer is responsible for the title and registration application of motor vehicles, driver’s license renewals at the Tonganoxie Annex, and performs the function of a bank for all revenue-generating County departments and invests tax dollars SCAM ALERT! Our office has been made aware of scam text messages being sent to Kansas residents claiming they owe money for a traffic violation. These messages often include a link and demand immediate payment. Please be aware that our office/Kansas Department of Revenue does not send text messages requesting payment for traffic violations . If you receive a text message claiming to be from our office or from KDOR regarding a traffic ticket or unpaid violation: Do no click links. Do not provide personal or payment information. Delete the message. We have included an example of what the text message might look like below. REAL ESTATE TAX BILLS MAILED Online tax payments are now available to pay online at the link below. The Leavenworth County Treasurer’s Office would like to inform residents that the real estate tax bills were mailed Nov 11th . If you do not receive your tax bill, please contact the Treasurer’s Office at (913) 684-0430 or email us at treasurer@leavenworthcounty.gov (Opens in new window) Please remember that1st half was due December 20nd and 2nd half payment are due by May 11th. to avoid penalties and interest. Payments can be made online by visiting our website, by mail or in person. Thank You, Leavenworth County Treasurer’s Office Property Tax Search (Opens in new window) Property Tax Payment (Opens in new window) SERVICE LOCATIONS: Leavenworth Courthouse 300 Walnut St Leavenworth, KS 66048 Directions (Opens in new window) | Tonganoxie Annex 725 Laming Rd Tonganoxie, KS 66086 Directions (Opens in new window) | Phone: 913-684-0430 Fax: 913-684-0436 | Phone: 913-364-5730 Fax: 913-364-5736 | 8:00 a.m to 4:55 p.m Mon-Fri | 7:30 a.m to 4:00 p.m Mon-Fri | In addition to collecting taxes and registering vehicles, the Annex can: Renew driver licenses Monday through Thursday from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. by walk in only , as long as you do not have a CDL or CNC (Conceal and Carry). Note: If you need to change your state of residence on your license, you will need to go to a Kansas DMV location, you can contact the Leavenworth DMV at 913-651-6947. - Address Change - Real I.D - Renew ID Cards for individuals that do not have a CDL, and only issue ID Cards for individuals that are age 16 and under or has disabilities Driver's license office will not be open on the last day of the month due to the volume of motor vehicle registrations. - NOTE: Drivers license are Cash or Check only | We now accept Master Card, Visa, Discover, American Express and Debit Cards as forms of payment for vehicle registration and tax payments, when you come into our office. Note: There is a 2.65% convenience fee charged by the credit card companies that goes directly to that company. NOTE: Please make checks payable to Leavenworth County Treasurer For more information on vehicle registration, property tax and to download forms please go to: http://www.kansastreasurers.org http://www.ksrevenue.org | OFFICE HOURS: Normal office hours are 8:00 a.m. to 4:55 p.m. NOTE : Title work will end at 4:30 Title work at the Annex will stop at 3:30PM ONLINE RENEWAL INFORMATION: Online Renewals (Opens in new window) If you have done an online renewal of your registration/tags, please allow 14 days for processing. COMMERCIAL VEHICLE REGISTRATION : Commercial transaction hours are 8:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. Both the Leavenworth and Tonganoxie locations can process CMV transactions.
